{{Top|leg}}
'''Sageoval's Decom Mission Transport Yards''' was a decommissioned vehicle yard located just north of [[Kuat City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. The largely outdoor facility contained numerous retired military vehicles, including early production [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]], armored personnel carriers, modular [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] that had failed military evaluation, and old [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the orbital base [[Rimsaw Station]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, visited the yard and purchased two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] starfighters from the attending [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Unidentified Besalisk salesman|salesman]] in exchange for the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] they stole from the ''[[Concussor]]'', an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]] that the Wraiths commandeered.<ref name="MK" />
